positionalToleranceBasis: MEASURED 2026-09-01, not guessed. Every ne_10m DEU boundary vertex in the Oder/Neisse corridor (lon 14.0-15.2, lat 50.8-53.0; n=181) was compared against the geoBoundaries gbOpen DEU ADM0 boundary (64,811 vertices, official German source, Datenlizenz Deutschland by-2.0): displacement min 1 m, p50 674 m, p90 1365 m, p95 1501 m, max 2110 m. The same measurement in the Torne corridor (FIN, lon 23.0-24.5, lat 65.5-68.5; n=182) reads p50 416 m, p90 949 m, p95 1285 m, max 3361 m. 1500 m is the p95 of the worse corridor. It is a property of THIS DATASET, not of the resolver: swap in per-country official geometry and the tolerance drops with it.
coastalToleranceBasis: Coastline generalisation puts real coastal addresses OUTSIDE their own country polygon: Kobenhavn (55.6761, 12.5683) measures 140 m outside ne_10m DNK, so a containment-only resolver reports "no country" for the Danish capital. A point outside every candidate polygon is attributed to the nearest one only when it is within this distance AND beats the runner-up by more than positionalToleranceM; otherwise it refuses.
neighboursNote: L-12887 (2026-09-02): REFUSAL-ONLY members - the un-modelled land neighbours of the 16 claimable countries, from the SAME pinned ne_10m source (sourceSha256 above, re-verified byte-identical on extraction day). A point contained by (or decisively nearest to) one of these polygons is REFUSED 'claimed-by-unmodelled-neighbour', never claimed for a modelled country - the nearest-polygon rescue and the tolerance band previously had no rival to lose to where the true owner was absent, which annexed Vaduz to CH, Monaco to FR, Athus to LU, Cesky Tesin to PL (by containment), Ivangorod/Sovetsk to EE/LT, Valka to EE, Fnideq to ES. L-12887 names 12 (CZE/LVA/BEL/AUT/LIE/RUS/BLR/AND/MCO/SMR/SVN/MAR); SVK, UKR, GIB and VAT are the same class (land neighbours of POL/POL/ESP/ITA within annexation range) and were added by the same extraction - recorded in the lane doc, E4 control 10. RUS/UKR/BLR/MAR are clipped to windows whose artificial edges are >100 km from every modelled routing bbox, which for a refusal-only member is correctness-preserving: clipping can only turn one refusal reason into another in un-modelled land, never mint a claim. Rings wholly outside every modelled routing bbox padded 0.5 deg are pruned on the same argument. Same DP-100m simplification, same 5-decimal rounding as the 16 claimable members.
